Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Dezvoltare de software
We are looking for an Android Developer to join a SAFe Agile team developing mobile banking applications.
 Responsibilities: 
Design, develop, and maintain native Android applications.
Collaborate with Product Owners and technical teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
Develop reusable components and participate in code reviews.
Perform unit testing, debugging, and issue resolution.
Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement initiatives.
 Requirements: 
2-3+ years of experience in Android development.
Strong knowledge of Kotlin .
Experience with ReactiveX (RxJava) and Kotlin Coroutines .
Understanding of Agile methodologies and SAFe environment.
Experience with Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket .
 French language skills (B1 level or higher). 
Strong communication skills and a proactive mindset.
 Nice to have: 
Experience with Jetpack Compose .
Previous exposure to banking or financial services projects.
